dedupe_keys.name: eurominenet multitemporal sentinel 2 benchmark for mining footprint analysis in the european union 2015 2024 hzdr

description: EuroMineNet is a multitemporal Sentinel-2 benchmark for mapping mining footprints and their change across the European Union from 2015 to 2024, published with a paper in the ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (2026). The RODARE record, published on 11 May 2026 by Weikang Yu, Vincent Nwazelibe, Xianping Ma, Xiaokang Zhang, Richard Gloaguen, Xiao Xiang Zhu and Pedram Ghamisi, holds one zip file of about 18.4 GB, free to download under CC BY 4.0. Beyond the title, the page read does not state the number of sites, labels or file layout, so those are not stated on the page read and must be taken from the archive or the paper. Caveats: the benchmark targets algorithm development, not an official inventory, and the dataset is very large. For simulation it gives a ten-year, EU-wide time series of labelled mining footprints, for tracking expansion of extraction sites relevant to the EU critical raw materials agenda and for exposure of mines to floods and landslides. Related catalogue records include MineNetCD from the same group, the EU Raw Materials Information System and the Maus global mining polygons.
